name: Магазин и заказы
description: Клиенты, заказы и JOIN. Обычный день против большой распродажи.
seed_sql:
INSERT INTO public.customers
SELECT i, i % 20, 'customer-' || i FROM generate_series(1, 2000) AS g(i);
INSERT INTO public.orders
SELECT i, (i % 2000 + 1)::integer, (i % 5)::integer,
       ((i * 37) % 10000)::integer,
       timestamp '2026-01-01' + i * interval '1 minute'
FROM generate_series(1, 100000) AS g(i);

queries.sql: SELECT id, total FROM public.orders WHERE customer_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, total FROM public.orders WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT o.id, o.total FROM public.orders o INNER JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.region = 7 AND o.total >= 5000 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

tables.name: public.customers
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON public.customers USING btree (id)

tables.name: public.orders
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON public.orders USING btree (id)
